change: Eligible templated bottom-side blocks gain three checked quarter-turn offers in compact mode, preserving the original bottom offer. Rotated groups are rigidly rebased and their declared envelope expanded to contain actual courtyard extents before unchanged local contract/boundary checks.
root_cause: Top templates already receive four orientations. Bottom templates returned only their mirror. The generic orientation helper excludes external contracts, so it could not supply missing power-stage turns. A naive extension was then rejected by a real 0.15mm U20003 courtyard protrusion beyond the template envelope despite all 20 local power structures passing.
safety: Existing layer/connector/controlled-net eligibility remains unchanged. All offsets on both faces translate together; rotations, mirrored footprint identities and net ownership are retained. Extents round outward. External flow/facing, thermal and full board checks remain downstream acceptance conditions.

tests.coverage: Explicit carrier power and power_som either-layer fixtures require bottom/r90, bottom/r180 and bottom/r270. Independently check local contracts, rigid offsets up to common translation, unchanged face membership and mirror binding, every final courtyard inside the advertised envelope, and exact bottom quantization observer/receipt equality. Existing orientation, pin-net, chirality, eligibility and incumbent tests pass.

limits: Whole-template orientation support, not general mixed-face power-stage partitioning. No new smaller accepted board or full qualification; qualified reference PCB outputs unchanged. Diagnostic single-run timings are not speedup evidence or a historical Python comparison.
